info.title: LexiSharp.Cli
info.description: Command-line tool for LexiSharp: index a directory into a persistent segment store, search a corpus from the terminal, and run the benchmark, diff and baseline commands. The core library is the LexiSharp package.

options.name: --queries
options.description: Labeled queries: a JSON object {"id": "text", ...} or a TSV 'id\ttext'

options.name: --configs
options.description: Comma-separated: bm25, bm25-tuned, tfidf, ql, hybrid, bm25-semantic, bm25f, bm25f-title, bm25f-tuned, bm25-proximity, bm25-proximity-full, bm25-proximity-boost, bm25+, bm25+-tuned, bm25l, bm25l-tuned (default: bm25,tfidf,ql,hybrid,bm25-tuned)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --qrels
options.description: Relevance judgments: TSV 'qid\tdocid[\tgrade]', one per line ('#' comments)

options.name: --top-k
options.description: Retrieval depth for every metric (default: 10)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Cap the number of queries evaluated (default: all)

options.name: --metric
options.description: Objective the *-tuned configs maximize: precision, recall, f1, ndcg (default: f1)

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the results as JSON to this file

options.name: --baseline
options.description: The reference configuration (same names as --configs)

options.name: --candidate
options.description: The configuration being evaluated

options.name: --epsilon
options.description: Score difference ignored when calling a query moved (default: 1e-9)

options.name: --out
options.description: Where to write the baseline

options.name: --against
options.description: The baseline to check against
